notes.title: Aim Trainer - Shooting Range: Release Date Announcement!
notes.content:
Greetings everyone!

We are proud to announce the release date of Aim Trainer - Shooting Range, available February 21th, 2024.

We are all super excited for the community to get their hands on the build. We appreciate all the feedback we have received the past few months. It’s been fun and invaluable to listen to everyone’s ideas and suggestions, we couldn’t have done it without you!

Much love!
- Merla Games
